svg.title: Precast beam yard
svg.desc: One 240 × 140 m yard • Eight 10 m beams per productive day • Single-tier storage

g.text: One 240 × 140 m yard • Eight 10 m beams per productive day • Single-tier storage
People gate → protected access to QA, welfare and gated work areas
Casting beds • two banks of eight 12 m positions
Daily pour 8 / second bank allows one day before reuse
Inbound deliveries → one-way haul road and crane loading apron → inspection gate / road convoy
Dispatch booking links the marked beam, transport saddles, lift window and destination pier.
Module plot 33,600 m² • Access aisles, crane lanes, outriggers, trailer turning and ground capacity require checking.
Bed turnover, concrete release strength, road closures and eight daily site lifts require agreement with suppliers and site teams.
